schema:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

unexplored.note: 停止不是化学终点;存在 deferred/知识缺口时不称“所有路线都探索完”;claimed/open attempt 是仍在执行的未完成工作,存在时不报 exhausted_search

frozen_plan_binding.note: 后段锚定:root retrieve 已 done(B3/B4)时执行层核验不可达,本核对在 resume 首消费前闭合

driver_session.note: flock 是执行权权威;崩溃 OS 自动释放

native_result.note: S4a 对象底座:完整字段 + 确定性规范化(同事实同 digest);正式文件导出见 native_export

native_export.note: S4b 正式文件导出(全量事实 + manifest 新鲜度锚);读取/消费走 read_native_export(首消费:missing/corrupt/version/policy/stale/reference 拒)

v3_projection.note: v3 有损投影(lossy_projection;原生引用 + 信息损失清单);反向消费禁止 —— 不得从投影改写原生事实/事件;读取走 read_v3_projection

schema:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)
